intent: This repository's inbox becomes personal; its shared notes move to an artifact
notes: Applies #104 to this repository: `.gator/inbox.md` is untracked (the file stays on disk as the Architect's own notes) and `.gitignore` gains its rule, plus two credential-file rules this repository had not converged on yet (`.gemini/.env`, `.codex/auth.json`).

The inbox's shared material moved first, to `artifacts/2026-11-22-shared-notes-from-inbox.md`: the roadmap retention standard, the Paper and inspection-workspace design decisions, the Loop planning-time heuristic and two observations without an issue. The stale "where we are" and backlog-index sections were dropped; GitHub Issues and Git hold that history.

Of the two unfiled bugs, the Repo view late-load race is still in the code and is now #111; the `gator loop codex` settings loss was already fixed by #87. Machine state (local database, paths, machine ID) stays in the personal inbox and is not committed.
`roadmap.md` and the issue-filing procedure no longer point readers at the inbox.
